_comment: Human descriptions for the vault indexer schema. Single source of truth.
Consumed by scripts/gen-vault-indexer-docs.mjs, which renders them into the
Schema Reference page, and by src/components/GraphQLRunner, which attaches
them to the schema so GraphiQL's Docs panel carries the same prose.
The deployed SDL owns the schema's SHAPE. This file only adds prose, so a
field removed upstream simply stops being annotated and a stale description
can never invent one. Links must be absolute site paths, because this text
is rendered both as MDX and as GraphiQL markdown.
Priority goes to fields that mislead: units that are not what the name
suggests, nullability that looks like missing data, values never written.

types.vault: One BTCVault and its full lifecycle state — a depositor’s native Bitcoin locked in a UTXO on the Bitcoin network. `status` is the authority on where it sits; the timestamp fields cover only part of the path.
types.vaultActivity: Append-only event log. It records six of the nine `vaultActivityType` values — `deposit`, `borrow`, `repay`, `redeem`, `liquidation` and `claim_expired`. It is not a complete history of everything that happens to a vault. See [Known data gaps](/trustless-bitcoin-vault/apis/limits-and-gotchas).
types.vaultProvider: The depositor's Vault Provider: the operator that sets up, redeems and defends the BTCVault. A depositor can run their own.
types.vaultKeeper: An App Keeper: the operator appointed by an integrated application, holding claim and challenge rights under that application's rules.
types.vaultKeeperApplication: Join between an App Keeper and an application.
types.universalChallenger: A Universal Challenger: one of a global set of operators with challenge-only rights, which challenges invalid claims across every BTCVault.
types.feeConfig: Fee configuration. Empty on testnet — fee escrows exist without a matching config row.
types.vaultFeeEscrow: Escrowed fees for one vault. One row per vault, keyed by `vaultId`.
types.application: A DeFi protocol integrated with the vault system. Aave v4 is the first.
types.token: A token known to the indexer, keyed by contract address.
types.protocolState: Protocol-level singleton state, such as the active vault-core version.
types.aavePosition: A depositor position in Aave, keyed by depositor address rather than by `id`.
types.aavePositionCollateral: One vault pledged as collateral against a position. Released rows are kept for history.
types.aaveVaultStatus: Per-vault usage status within Aave, keyed by `vaultId`.
types.aaveUserProxy: The proxy contract deployed for a user, keyed by `user`.
types.aaveReserve: An Aave reserve and its parameters. Join here to resolve debt amounts.
types.aaveConfig: Aave integration configuration. Singleton with an `Int` id — pass `1`, not `"1"`.

fields.vault.status: Where the vault is in its lifecycle. Treat this as authoritative; not every state has a timestamp.
fields.vault.inUse: Whether the vault is currently pledged to an application.
fields.vault.ackCount: How many of the security set have acknowledged. Reaches 6 when complete. A vault sitting at 0 is stalling, and usually expires with `ack_timeout`.
fields.vault.expirationReason: Why the peg-in expired, for example `ack_timeout`.
fields.vault.claimExpiredUntil: **A block number, not a timestamp**, despite sitting among the timestamp fields. The contract sets it to the expiry block plus a grace period. Compare it against the block in `_meta`, never against a clock.
fields.vault.depositor: Depositor address, lowercase hex. Filters are case-sensitive.
fields.vaultActivity.vaultId: **Null on `borrow` and `repay`.** Those events are scoped to an Aave position rather than to one vault. This is by design, not missing data.
fields.vaultActivity.amount: Satoshis **except** on `borrow` and `repay`, where it is denominated in the debt asset. Resolve `debtReserveId` against `aaveReserve` before formatting.
fields.vaultActivity.debtReserveId: Set on `borrow` and `repay`. Join to `aaveReserve` for the debt asset symbol and decimals.
fields.vaultActivity.type: In practice one of `deposit`, `borrow`, `repay`, `redeem`, `liquidation`, `claim_expired`. The enum also declares `withdrawal`, `add_collateral` and `remove_collateral`, but nothing writes them.
fields.vaultActivity.timestamp: Unix seconds. Use with `timestamp_gt` as a sync watermark.
fields.aavePosition.depositorAddress: The key for this entity. Query with `aavePosition(depositorAddress: "0x…")`.
fields.aavePosition.totalCollateral: Satoshis. Equals the sum of `amount` across collateral rows where `removedAt` is null.
fields.aavePositionCollateral.removedAt: Null while the vault is still pledged. Filter on `removedAt: null` for live collateral.
fields.aaveReserve.underlyingToken: The reserve asset. Read `symbol` and `decimals` to format borrow and repay amounts.
fields.aaveReserve.borrowable: Whether the reserve can be borrowed. The `vaultBTC` reserve, which represents BTCVault collateral, is collateral only.
fields.vaultProviderStats.totalActiveSats: Satoshis across the provider's active vaults.
fields.vaultProviderStats.activeVaultCount: Number of active vaults for this provider.
fields.token.decimals: Decimal places for this token. Needed to format any amount denominated in it.

pageFields.totalCount: Total rows matching the filter, not the number returned on this page.
pageFields.pageInfo: Cursors for this page. Both cursors are null once you pass `offset`.
